zh.title: 美國航空公布2027夏季七條新航線
zh.summary: 美國航空公布2027夏季；新增波圖、維也納、凱夫拉維克
body: 美國航空（American Airlines）於2026年8月27日公布2027年夏季賽季的七條新國際航線，其中包含兩個全新的歐洲目的地：波多（OPO）與維也納（VIE），兩條直飛航線均由費城（PHL）樞紐營運。
美國航空將成為唯一營運奧地利首都的美國籍航空公司。維也納機場執行長Julian Jäger接受AeroTime採訪時表示，吸引至少一家美國航空公司進駐是航線發展的優先事項。
冰島凱夫拉維克國際機場（KEF）也將重新納入該公司網絡，美航曾在2019年停飛該航線。波線與維也納航線將採用新的空中巴士A321XLR（ICAO機型代碼A21N）營運，而凱夫拉維克則由標準版A321neo執飛。
波線服務將於2027年3月28日開航，維也納與凱夫拉維克則分別於同日五月6日與28日開航。美航也利用A321XLR進駐機隊，部署於紐約（JFK）至阿姆斯特丹史基浦（AMS）與尼斯蔚藍海岸（NCE）等新航線。
巴塞隆納（BCN）自2027年5月27日起將有飛往美國的每日不停站航班，採用波音777-200（B77W）營運；芝加哥歐海爾（ORD）至東京成田（NRT）航線自2027年3月19日起以波音787-9每日營運，紐約至倫敦希斯洛（LHR）也將新增第四班每日航班。
美航也證實將於2027年春季恢復夏洛特至巴黎（CDG）與邁阿密（MIA）至米蘭馬勒彭薩（MXP）的季節性航線。

en.title: American Airlines adds seven European routes for summer 2027, including Porto, Vienna and Keflavik
en.summary: American Airlines unveils seven 2027 routes; new Porto, Vienna, Keflavik, plus more
body: American Airlines has unveiled seven new international routes for the 2027 summer season, announced on August 27, 2026. The carrier will add two new European destinations to its network: Porto (OPO) and Vienna (VIE), with both nonstop services operated from its Philadelphia (PHL) hub.

American will also become the only US carrier serving Vienna. In a recent exclusive interview with AeroTime, Vienna Airport CEO Julian Jäger said that attracting at least one US carrier to the Austrian capital was a route development priority.
Keflavik International Airport (KEF) in Iceland will also be added to the network, although this is more of a comeback, as American had previously served the destination before dropping it in 2019.

Both Porto and Vienna will be served by American Airlines' new Airbus A321XLR, while Keflavik will be operated by a regular A321neo, since the standard version has enough range to reach Iceland from the East Coast of the United States.

The Porto service starts March 28, 2027, while Vienna and Keflavik begin May 6 and 28, 2027, respectively. American is also leveraging the A321XLR on new routes linking New York (JFK) to Amsterdam-Schiphol (AMS) and Nice-Côte d'Azur (NCE).

Barcelona (BCN) will see a new nonstop service, planned to start May 27, 2027 with a Boeing 777-200 daily. A new route from Chicago O'Hare (ORD) to Tokyo-Narita (NRT) will be operated daily with a Boeing 787-9 from March 19, 2027, and a fourth daily frequency between New York (JFK) and London-Heathrow (LHR) with B787-9s. The airline will also bring back seasonal routes, Charlotte to Paris (CDG) and Miami to Milan Malpensa (MXP), in spring 2027.

zh.title: 新加坡將首辦旅客航站區博覽會亞洲展九月登場
zh.summary: 新加坡九月首辦PTE Asia；逾3500專業人士參與；孫雪齡致開幕詞
body: 新加坡將於2026年9月23至24日在 Sands Expo & Convention Centre 舉辦首屆旅客航站區博覽會亞洲展（PTE Asia）。交通部及國家發展部政務次長孫雪齡將以榮譽嘉賓身分出席並致開幕詞。
主辦單位預計吸引逾3,500名產業專業人士、200位專家講者及125家展商參與。根據國際機場理事會亞太及中東地區預測，2025至2028年間亞太區旅客流量將年增4.8%，中東地區年增5.4%。東南亞主要機場擴建計畫投資金額至少達400億美元，延續至2030年代初中葉。
大會議程涵蓋聯網旅客體驗、智慧機場營運、永續與氣候領導、投資與商業收入、機場規劃、未來防禦總體規劃及先進空中交通等核心領域。活動總監 Dominic Pinfold 指出：「增長數據令人信服，但真正挑戰在於機場如何將投資轉化為產能、韌性及更好的旅客旅程。新加坡是亞洲、中東及其他地區機場領袖比較成功經驗、審視新興技術並建立下一階段增長夥伴關係的理想場所。」

主要贊助商暨展商包含 AIS-Hill、Vanderlande、Rapiscan Systems、SJ Group、Mitsubishi Elevator、Populous、find inc、Copenhagen Optimization、TAV Technologies、DXC Technology、Analogic Corporation 及 Garrett，涵蓋航廈設計、行李處理、安檢、垂直運輸、旅客流量管理及機場技術等領域。會議期間，Snapsight 將提供 AI 生成的議程摘要、可搜尋洞察、即時字幕及多語言逐字稿，並透過 QR 碼呈現動態觀念雲以利追蹤平行議程。
新加坡樟宜機場（SIN）集團另安排兩場限額參觀：9月22日探訪新一代智慧航廈規劃，9月25日深入體驗 FAST（Fast and Seamless Travel）自動化旅客流程。博覽通行證免費，大會代表證供應商及顧問為新幣500元，合資格機場、航空公司及公部門人員可獲免費大會代表資格（經審核確認）。報名網址為 pte-asia.com/visit-pte-asia/registr。

en.title: Singapore to host inaugural Passenger Terminal Expo Asia in September 2026
en.summary: Singapore hosts first PTE Asia Sept 23-24; 3,500+ attendees; Sun Xueling opens
body: Singapore will host the inaugural Passenger Terminal Expo Asia (PTE Asia) on 23–24 September 2026 at the Sands Expo & Convention Centre. Ms Sun Xueling, Senior Minister of State for Transport and National Development, will attend as Guest of Honour and deliver the opening address.

Organizers expect more than 3,500 industry professionals, 200 expert speakers, and 125 exhibitors. Airports Council International Asia-Pacific & Middle East forecasts annual passenger traffic growth of 4.8% in Asia-Pacific and 5.4% in the Middle East between 2025 and 2028. Major disclosed airport developments across Southeast Asia represent at least US$40 billion in investment extending into the early-to-mid-2030s.

The conference programme covers connected passenger experience, intelligent airport operations, sustainability and climate leadership, investment and commercial revenue, airport planning, future-proof master planning, and advanced air mobility. Event Director Dominic Pinfold said: "The growth figures are compelling, but the real challenge is how airports translate investment into capacity, resilience and a better passenger journey. Singapore is an ideal place for airport leaders from Asia, the Middle East and beyond to compare what is working, examine emerging technology and build the partnerships needed for the next phase of growth."

Key sponsors and exhibitors include AIS-Hill, Vanderlande, Rapiscan Systems, SJ Group, Mitsubishi Elevator, Populous, find inc, Copenhagen Optimization, TAV Technologies, DXC Technology, Analogic Corporation, and Garrett, spanning terminal design, baggage handling, security screening, vertical transport, passenger flow, and airport technology. Snapsight will provide AI-generated session summaries, searchable insights, live captions, and multilingual transcripts via QR code, with Dynamic Idea Clouds visualising emerging themes across parallel sessions.

Changi Airport (SIN) Group offers two limited-capacity tours: a 22 September session on next-generation smart terminal plans, and a 25 September behind-the-scenes tour of FAST (Fast and Seamless Travel) examining technology and automation for smoother passenger journeys. Expo passes are complimentary; conference delegate passes cost SGD500 for suppliers, consultants, and industry professionals, while qualifying airport, airline, and public-sector professionals receive complimentary access subject to review. Registration is available at pte-asia.com/visit-pte-asia/registr.

zh.title: 摩爾多瓦國慶閱兵前五架無人機入侵領空
zh.summary: 摩爾多瓦國軍記錄五起無人機越界事件；國慶閱兵照常舉行
body: 摩爾多瓦國家陸軍記錄到五架未經授權的無人機於2026年8月27日凌晨飛越該國領空，數小時後該國在基希訥烏舉行獨立35週年閱兵。
國家陸軍空中作戰處表示，這些蹤跡是與夥伴共同建立，且飛行緊隨俄羅斯對烏克蘭的夜間空襲。每次飛越均沿東南邊界的Stefan Voda地區。
據報導，第一架無人機於當地時間03:56從Beleaevka方向進入，另一架於05:50在Saiti過境點越界，至06:02離開領空。五個物件中有兩個未追蹤到，第二架於04:10在Carahasani失蹤，第三架於04:24在Transnistrian地區的Pervomaisc失蹤。
聲明未報告殘骸，且未提及關閉空域或航班改道。

en.title: Five drones crossed Moldovan airspace hours before Independence Day parade
en.summary: Moldova's National Army records five unauthorized drone crossings; two tracks lost, no wreckage
body: Moldova's National Army recorded five unauthorized drone flights through national airspace during the early hours of August 27, 2026, hours before the country marked 35 years of independence with a military parade in Chișinău.

The National Army's Air Operations Service said the tracks were established jointly with partners and that the flights followed Russian air attacks on Ukraine overnight. Every crossing took place along the southeastern border in the Stefan Voda district.

According to the report, the first drone entered at 03:56 local time, and a fifth object moved across the border at the Saiti crossing at 05:50 and left toward Lesnoie at 06:02. Two of the five were never tracked out: the second disappeared at 04:10 near Carahasani, and the third at 04:24 near Pervomaisc.
The statement reported no wreckage and made no mention of an airspace closure or diversions.
